tools.name: motion_recipe
tools.title: Find runnable motion recipes
tools.description: Read the bundled original interactive motion catalog or one complete recipe by ID. Returns runnable source, integration guidance and evidence requirements for spring retargeting, scroll choreography, articulated 3D colonies, task handoffs, elapsed-time sequences, kinetic fields and drawers. No network, arbitrary file access, installation or source edits. Adapt to the user’s brief, then verify the real result.

tools.name: motion_capture
tools.title: Capture local motion evidence
tools.description: Run an explicit bounded click/hover/key/native drag/pointer/scroll recipe against a caller-chosen loopback URL and CSS target. Native drag uses selector-relative points in[0,1] with at most12 waypoints and2000ms held duration. Scroll deltas are limited to ±1200 pixels per action. Fresh browser; may change local app state. Saves actual WebM, screenshots and temporal evidence. Never imports credentials or edits code.

points.description: Ordered selector-relative coordinates in [0,1]; native pointer remains held through reversals. Border coordinates are inset half a CSS pixel.

end.description: Cancel uses a native held touch contact ending in pointercancel; default mouse drag releases normally.

durationMs.description: Total held drag time, 100–2000ms, included in capture deadline.

steps.description: Interpolation steps across the complete path; defaults to 24. Every supplied waypoint is visited, with at most 60 moves.

ms.description: Each wait is at most 4000ms; all waits total at most 10000ms. Leave room for actual input before the capture/outcome deadline.

durationMs.description: Entire recorded interaction window, maximum 12000ms. Includes input and waits. Use ordinary browser tools for longer journeys.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline from capture START, including all actions and waits; not an extra post-action timeout. Omit to use durationMs. Positive checks run after actions, so leave time before this deadline.

tools.name: motion_review
tools.title: Review one native motion journey
tools.description: Capture or reuse the exact declared journey, validate its transition plan and actor bindings, and return a compact review plus at most six native PNGs. Keeps functional delivery, geometry, app scene annotations, pixel review and preference separate. Supports a prior capture comparison. Does not edit source or certify aesthetic quality/FPS. May interact with the local app. No silent retries.

tools.name: motion_probe
tools.title: Probe bounded interruption offsets
tools.description: Replay one journey at one to five non-monotonic interruption offsets in fresh contexts. Reports every capture, actual input events, failures versus weak/incomplete infrastructure evidence and optional bounded greedy minimization. Total declared capture time capped at sixty seconds. No silent retries, source edits or remote origins.

tools.name: motion_inspect
tools.title: Inspect a motion capture
tools.description: Return compact measured contracts, findings, final state and artifact paths. Optionally return selected events and a bounded sample window; no arbitrary file reads.

tools.name: motion_compare
tools.title: Compare before/after motion evidence
tools.description: Compare measured temporal contracts and final state across two captures. Reports evidence deltas, not automated repair or an LLM benchmark.

tools.name: motion_frames
tools.title: See recorded motion frames
tools.description: Return up to six actual recorded-video frames as native MCP images. Choose journey to cover the full capture, or finding for a defect window. Detail bounds preserve aspect ratio and report downscaling; up to 1280×960. No rerendering, arbitrary paths or external URLs. Video-time alignment is approximate; use the trace for precise metrics.

tools.name: motion_list
tools.title: List local motion captures
tools.description: List IDs from this server’s configured evidence directory; does not search arbitrary files.
